data.notes: February’s strongest confirmed music calendar in Cartagena centered on heritage programming around Candelaria/Hay Festival, with a handful of verified club and concert one-offs rather than a dense international touring schedule.

events.title: Hay Festival Cartagena: El porro en concierto
events.summary: Rafael Pérez Alviz and Daniel Samper Pizano led a conversation on porro, followed by a live concert from Acorbanda de Colombia as part of Hay Festival Cartagena 2026.

events.title: XXVI Festival de la Cumbia a la manera cartagenera
events.venueName: Tarima del Frito – Monumento a los Zapatos Viejos
events.summary: The city-backed cumbia festival presented competitions and gala performances by folkloric music groups, dancers and new-song contestants within the Fiestas de la Candelaria program.

events.title: Simón Olano: Una noche en Cartagena
events.summary: Cartagenero singer-composer Simón Olano performed a romantic bolero and balada program under the Festival de Guitarras banner at Teatro Adolfo Mejía.

events.title: Charanga Joven en El Mirador
events.summary: El Mirador Culture Bar hosted Charanga Joven for a live Caribbean-music night with doors listed at 8:00 p.m.

events.title: Candlelight: Las Cuatro Estaciones de Vivaldi
events.summary: The Candlelight series presented Vivaldi’s Four Seasons in a one-hour candlelit string-quartet concert at Palacio de la Proclamación.

events.title: Candlelight: Tributo a Adele
events.summary: A Candlelight tribute concert reworked Adele songs for a live chamber setting at Palacio de la Proclamación.

events.title: Dragón y Caballero en Andrés
events.summary: The Colombian duo Dragón y Caballero were listed for a live show at Andrés Carne de Res Cartagena, billed as a night of romance, party energy and live performance.

events.title: Trío Musical del IPCC at Plaza de Variedades
events.venueName: Plaza de Variedades, Parque Espíritu del Manglar
events.summary: The official city program for Plaza de Variedades opened its weekend with a free presentation by the Trío Musical del IPCC following an IDER rumbaterapia session.

events.title: Rueda de Bullerengue: la plaza es de todos y para todos
events.venueName: Plaza de Variedades, Parque Espíritu del Manglar
events.summary: The free Plaza de Variedades program featured a bullerengue-focused cultural afternoon with cantadora Emelia Reyes “La Burgo,” Vivian Pérez and Irving Vanegas.

events.title: Miércoles en Taboo Disco Club with DJ Jossi Guerra
events.summary: Taboo Disco Club listed a Wednesday club night with DJ Jossi Guerra at its Getsemaní venue.

events.title: #TinderParty en el rooftop de Viajero Getsemaní
events.summary: Viajero Getsemaní’s rooftop hosted a free public #TinderParty with live DJs from late afternoon into the night.
